name: STRM Sync
description: Writes .strm files for Dispatcharr's movies and series by hand, after each M3U refresh or on a schedule, so Emby, Jellyfin or Plex can add them as normal libraries. Open the dashboard with the Docs link.
author: emby-xtream

fields.label: Where the files go
fields.description: Dashboard: open /logos/strm_sync/index.html on this Dispatcharr address (the Docs link above). Syncing by hand works straight away. For the automatic and scheduled syncs, restart Dispatcharr once after enabling or updating the plugin.

fields.label: STRM folder (inside the Dispatcharr container)
fields.help_text: The right-hand side of the volume line in docker-compose.yml, for example /strm for '- C:/Users/you/STRM:/strm'. Movies go to <folder>/Movies and series to <folder>/Shows.

fields.label: Dispatcharr address as your media server reaches it
fields.help_text: Written into every .strm file. Use an address that works from the Emby machine, not localhost unless both run on the same machine.

fields.label: When to sync
fields.description: You can always sync by hand with the buttons below or on the dashboard. A refresh and a schedule can both be on.

fields.label: Sync after each M3U refresh
fields.help_text: Starts when Dispatcharr has finished loading the account's movies and series.

fields.label: Hours between syncs (every few hours)
fields.help_text: Counted from the last sync, including one run by hand.

fields.label: Time of day (once a day)
fields.help_text: 24-hour time, in the time zone set in Dispatcharr's system settings.

fields.label: Names and folders
fields.description: Layout: Movies/Title (Year) [tmdbid=1]/Title (Year) [tmdbid=1].strm and Shows/Show/Season 01/Show - S01E01 - Title.strm

fields.label: Add [tmdbid=...] to folder names
fields.help_text: Lets Emby and Jellyfin match titles straight away. Uses the TMDB id Dispatcharr already has.

fields.label: Add the year to titles that lack one
Clean up names
fields.help_text: Removes provider tags such as |UK|, 'EN - ' or '4K-NF - ' from the start of titles.

fields.label: Also remove these terms from names
Categories to leave out
fields.help_text: One category name per line. * is a wildcard, for example *XXX* or FR - *. Categories switched off in Dispatcharr's VOD settings are always left out.

fields.label: Write .nfo files with the TMDB id
Versions and playback
fields.description: A title that more than one provider carries can get one file per provider, which Emby shows as versions.

options.label: Dispatcharr proxy (no login in the files)
Xtream URL (Dispatcharr shows which user is watching)

fields.label: That user's Xtream password (Xtream URL only)
fields.help_text: The XC password from the user's profile in Dispatcharr, not an admin login. It is written into the .strm files.

fields.label: Episode lists
fields.description: Dispatcharr only loads a show's episodes when someone opens it. The plugin asks for the missing ones, one show at a time, and again when the provider changes a show.

fields.label: Ask the IPTV provider for missing episode lists
fields.help_text: Off: no requests go to your IPTV provider, and only shows whose episodes Dispatcharr already has (shows someone has opened) get files. Movies never need the provider.

fields.label: Most shows to fetch per sync (0 = no limit)
fields.help_text: The first sync asks the provider once per show. Set a limit to spread a large catalogue over several syncs.

fields.label: Clean-up
fields.description: Only .strm files this plugin wrote are ever removed. Your own files in the same folders stay.

fields.label: Remove files for titles Dispatcharr no longer has
Removal safety limit (%)
fields.help_text: With more than 10 files, a sync never removes more than this share at once. 0 turns the limit off.

fields.label: Media server (optional)
fields.description: Starts a library scan in Emby or Jellyfin when a sync changed files.

actions.label: Sync movies and series
actions.description: Runs in the background. Follow it on the dashboard.

actions.label: Stop the running sync
actions.description: Files already written are kept and nothing is removed.

actions.label: Delete all movie files
actions.description: Removes every movie .strm this plugin wrote.

confirm.title: Delete all movie files?
confirm.message: Every movie .strm file this plugin wrote will be removed. Your own files stay.

actions.label: Delete all series files
actions.description: Removes every episode .strm this plugin wrote.

confirm.title: Delete all series files?
confirm.message: Every episode .strm file this plugin wrote will be removed. Your own files stay.
